title: Orb strategy day 84
summary: Took a 5-minute ORB setup on gold today. Price was trading above both the EMA and the VWAP, so the bias was bullish going into the breakout. After the 5M ORB range formed, price broke to the upside and I entered on the retest. The setup looked clean, but there was no follow-through. Price reversed quickly, slipped back into the range, and stopped me out before any real push could develop.submitted by/u/NeighborhoodSpare917[link][comments]
